scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:apps
scripts.build:packages: npm run -w @lessonkit/core build && npm run -w @lessonkit/xapi build && npm run -w @lessonkit/accessibility build && npm run -w @lessonkit/themes build && npm run -w @lessonkit/lxpack build && npm run -w @lessonkit/react build && npm run -w @lessonkit/cli build
scripts.build:apps: npm run -w lessonkit-example-react-vite build && npm run -w lessonkit-example-lxpack-golden build && npm run -w lessonkit-example-data-privacy build && npm run -w lessonkit-example-customer-service build && npm run -w lessonkit-template-vite-react build
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run --workspaces --if-present typecheck
